intentions: Design and implement a database schema for expense tracking with SQLite, including models for Category, Expense, and Budget with constraints like UNIQUE(category_id, month) for budgets
Create repositories for Category, Expense, and Budget with CRUD operations and filtering capabilities (date range, category, payment method)
Implement a service layer for expense management with business logic for filtering, aggregation, budget checks, and recurring expense detection
Develop a CLI interface using Click for expense tracking commands (category management, budget management, expense management, reporting, and recurring expense detection)
Handle monetary values as integers (cents) for precision, with conversion utilities for display purposes
Implement custom exceptions for error handling (e.g., CategoryNotFoundError, ExpenseNotFoundError, BudgetExceededException)
Ensure proper type hints throughout the codebase and enforce foreign key constraints in SQLite
